Landing.eyebrow: A logic game for unhurried minds
Landing.title: Crack the code. Learn from every clue.
Landing.intro: Cipherboard turns the classic Mastermind puzzle into a focused daily practice, a private contest between friends, and a game you can begin immediately.
Landing.stepOneBody: Choose one marked peg for each position. Every colour also has a symbol, so the board never relies on colour alone.
Landing.stepTwoBody: A solid clue means the right peg in the right place. An outlined clue means the right peg in another place.
Landing.stepThreeBody: Use the history on the board to rule possibilities in or out before your attempts run out.
Landing.soloBody: Four official difficulties, a flexible custom mode, and pass-and-play for a human Code Maker.
Landing.dailyBody: Everyone receives the same official code each UTC day, with one fair ranked run.
Landing.friendsBody: Send an asynchronous challenge or meet in a private real-time duel without revealing anyone’s guesses.
Landing.fairBody: The server owns secrets, feedback, timing, scores, and rankings. Active codes never enter browser storage or analytics.
Landing.accessibleBody: Symbols, patterns, text labels, keyboard play, clear focus, and reduced motion make the board usable beyond colour perception.
Landing.ctaTitle: There is always another line of reasoning.
Landing.ctaBody: Start as a guest. Create an account later to sync history, achievements, and public rankings.

Guide.title: Rules and strategy
Guide.intro: Mastermind is a game of controlled experiments: make a guess, read two kinds of evidence, and narrow the possible codes.
Guide.objectiveBody: Find the hidden sequence within the allowed attempts. Each position holds one enabled peg; some modes allow the same peg more than once.
Guide.exactBody: One guessed peg has the correct colour and position.
Guide.colourBody: One guessed peg exists in the code but belongs in a different position.
Guide.feedbackNote: Clues are totals, not mapped to guess positions. A peg can produce at most one clue.
Guide.keyboardBody: Tab into the palette, use arrow keys to move, Enter or Space to place a peg, Backspace to undo, and submit only after every position is filled.
Guide.strategyBody: Start with a guess that tests several distinct pegs. Keep pegs supported by clues, change unsupported pegs, and use exact-position clues to test one position at a time.
Guide.duplicatesBody: When duplicates are allowed, repeated guesses can test whether a colour appears more than once. Exact matches are counted before misplaced colours, so clues never double-count a peg.
Guide.fairnessBody: Official scores reward fewer attempts and harder configurations. Eligible solve time is used only to break tied scores. The server validates every attempt; custom games are unranked.

Auth.title: Sign in or continue as a guest
Auth.intro: Guest play starts immediately. Sign in to sync history across devices, keep achievements, export data, and choose a public display name.
Auth.sentBody: Use the secure link in the same browser to finish signing in.
Auth.privacy: Authentication is used to protect game ownership and sync progress. We do not require a real name or date of birth.
Auth.error: Sign-in could not be started. Please try again.
Auth.invalidCallback: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new secure link.

Account.title: Account and data
Account.intro: Control your identity, exports, active sessions, and account removal.
Account.upgradeBody: Data exports and account deletion belong to permanent accounts. Add an email sign-in to keep this guest’s games, then return here to manage the account.
Account.exportBody: Download your profile, verified game history, scores, achievements, and challenge metadata. Active secrets and authentication credentials are never included.
Account.deleteBody: Deletion revokes sessions, removes or anonymizes profile data and public display-name references, and preserves only records required for security and aggregate integrity.
Account.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Export your data first if you want a copy.
Account.deleteError: The deletion request could not be completed. Your account remains active.
Account.recentAuthRequired: For your protection, sign in again before deleting this account.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Cipherboard collects the minimum data needed to authenticate players, protect game fairness, operate multiplayer features, and provide requested history and rankings.
Privacy.collectBody: We process an account or anonymous identity, optional display name, verified game and challenge events, settings, security and audit records, and limited operational logs. Email is processed by the authentication provider for registered sign-in.
Privacy.notCollectBody: Active secret codes, complete guess sequences, authentication tokens, email addresses, raw IP addresses in product events, and private challenge content are not sent to product analytics. We do not use advertising trackers or sell personal data.
Privacy.useBody: Data is used to run games, restore progress, enforce ownership and rate limits, calculate verified statistics and leaderboards, moderate public names, investigate abuse, and improve reliability when analytics is enabled.
Privacy.retentionBody: You can opt out of public rankings and analytics, export account data, revoke challenges, or request account deletion. Security and anonymized integrity records may be retained for documented operational or legal needs.
Privacy.childrenBody: The service is intended for people aged 13 and above and does not ask for a date of birth unless a future legal requirement makes it necessary.
Privacy.contactBody: Use the support page for privacy questions or security concerns. This policy requires legal review before a public launch.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: These terms govern access to Cipherboard. They are written for launch readiness and require review by qualified counsel before public release.
Terms.eligibilityBody: You must be at least 13 and use accurate sign-in contact information when registering. You are responsible for protecting access to your account and private challenge links.
Terms.conductBody: Do not automate guesses, manipulate timing or rankings, enumerate private links, harass other players, impersonate staff, bypass access controls, or disrupt the service. We may invalidate results or restrict accounts to protect players and fairness.
Terms.serviceBody: Features may change, pause, or be withdrawn for security, maintenance, or operational reasons. Online-ranked play requires a network connection and authoritative server confirmation.
Terms.contentBody: You retain rights in optional display names and challenge titles while granting the limited permission needed to display and moderate them. Do not submit unlawful, abusive, or private third-party information.
Terms.disclaimerBody: The service is provided without promises beyond those required by applicable law. Applicable liability limits and governing law depend on the launch entity and jurisdiction.
Terms.contactBody: Contact support with questions about these terms.

Accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
Accessibility.intro: Cipherboard targets WCAG 2.2 Level AA and is designed so that colour is helpful but never the only source of meaning.
Accessibility.featuresBody: The board supports keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic landmarks, descriptive errors, screen-reader clue announcements, peg symbols and patterns, zoom, high contrast, reduced motion, and touch targets of at least 44 by 44 pixels.
Accessibility.knownBody: Live multiplayer quality depends on the browser’s WebSocket support and connection stability. When live state is unavailable, the interface explains the limitation and preserves safe unsubmitted input where possible.
Accessibility.feedbackBody: Tell us the page, device, browser, assistive technology, and problem through the support form. We treat access barriers as product defects.
Accessibility.compatibilityBody: We test current major browsers with keyboard navigation, screen readers, automated accessibility checks, 200% zoom, reduced motion, and common colour-vision simulations.

Support.title: Support
Support.intro: Report a gameplay, account, access, privacy, or security problem without including secret codes or authentication credentials.
Support.messageHint: Include the page, approximate time, and public game or room identifier if relevant. Never send a token or secret code.

Admin.intro: Protected operational controls. Every mutation requires an explicit server role, a reason, recent authentication where supported, and an audit event.

Admin.confirm: Apply this administrative action? The server will record the actor, target, reason, and timestamp.
Admin.empty: No operational records match this view.

Offline.title: You’re offline
Offline.body: Cipherboard can show this explanation and preserve a safe unsubmitted row, but starting or submitting an authoritative game requires a connection.
Offline.degradedBody: Solo play may remain available while live rooms, public rankings, or other shared features recover. The interface will never pretend an offline result is ranked.

Errors.errorBody: Your verified game data remains on the server. Retry the page; active sessions will resynchronize before accepting another guess.
Errors.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete, expired, revoked, or private. Return home or begin a new game.
